newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to detail more Korea Telecom share sales.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to detail more Korea Telecom share sales.

text.p: South Korea plans to release details this month for additional sales abroad of shares in unlisted Korea Telecom, a finance ministry official said on Tuesday.
The ministry has already said it will sell 500 billion won worth of shares in the state-run telecommunications company through issues of overseas depositary receipts in October.
"We will unveil the scale of the additional share sales by the end of this month," the official said.
A South Korean economic newspaper said the government planned to sell another 500 billion won worth of Korea Telecom shares. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5647
